Below is a summary of the problem plus three *SEARCH/REPLACE* patches against `src/transfer/view/transfer.jsx` that split out `searchProps` into left/right sub-props.  

---

### 1) Bug scenario & root cause

From your example you want to be able to do:

```jsx
<Transfer
  showSearch
  searchProps={{
    left:  { hasClear: true },
    right: { hasClear: false },
  }}
  …
/>
```

but today the `searchProps` you pass in ends up being spread wholesale onto _both_ the left and right `<Search/>` boxes.  In other words, `Transfer` currently only supports a single `searchProps` set, so you can’t customize or even hide one side independently.  

The fix is to detect when you’ve passed `searchProps.left` or `.right` and then pass just the left‐side config to the left panel and the right‐side config to the right panel, instead of giving both panels the same object.

---

With these changes:

- We first detect `searchProps.left` / `searchProps.right` (falling back to the original object if you didn’t supply sub-keys).
- We remove `searchProps`, `onSearch` and `searchPlaceholder` from the shared `panelProps`.
- We then spread `panelProps` into each `<TransferPanel/>` and immediately override with the correct `searchProps`, `onSearch` and `searchPlaceholder` for that side.

This allows you to hide or customize the left and right search boxes independently.
